title: Build 2D Top-Down Map Editor (@tool EditorPlugin)
description: A Godot @tool EditorPlugin for editing map_data.json visually — top-down 2D grid, paint structure heights, stamp utilities, place artifacts, live pathfinder validation.
earned_from: User tried web editor, voxel editor, raw JSON — none had tight enough loop. @tool plugin is the tightest: edit in same tool where you test.
summary: Godot @tool EditorPlugin: 2D top-down grid, 3 layer toggle, paint heights, stamp utilities, place artifacts, live pathfinder. Reads/writes map_data.json directly.

nodes.label: Create plugin.cfg + main EditorPlugin script
nodes.detail: addons/map_editor/plugin.cfg + map_editor_plugin.gd. Register a bottom panel or dock.

nodes.label: Build 2D grid renderer
nodes.detail: Draw grid cells colored by height (0=black void, 1-5=gray floor shades, 6=red wall). Click to paint. Scroll to zoom.

nodes.label: Layer toggle: structure / utilities / interactables
nodes.detail: Tabs or buttons. Show active layer opaque, dim others. Each layer paints different data.

nodes.label: Structure painting
nodes.detail: Select height 0-6, click/drag to paint cells. Palette bar showing heights with colors.

nodes.label: Utility stamps
nodes.detail: Toolbar with sp/t/r/tc/m/ds icons. Click cell to stamp. Shows icon on grid.

nodes.label: Artifact placement
nodes.detail: Search box with registry lookup. Click cell to place. Shows name on grid. Set rotation/y_offset.

nodes.label: Live pathfinder validation
nodes.detail: Run map_pathfinder rules on every edit. Flash unreachable cells red. Show spawn→teleporter path.

nodes.label: Save/load map_data.json
nodes.detail: Read on open, write on save. Preserve map_info, settings, lighting — only edit layers.

nodes.label: Test: edit → F5 → walk the map
nodes.detail: The tightest loop: paint in editor, press play, walk through it in VR/desktop.
